## Life at Luciq

A great place to work where we value openness, proactivity, and ownership. We focus on making things happen, keeping it real, balancing hard work with fun, and collaborating to deliver exceptional experiences to our users. Join us and live that #LuciqLife!

![Photo of the Luciq team](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/68d100cae362c5bf3ddd42a4_luciq_team.webp)

## Hear from the team

I began my career at Luciq with an internship that truly transformed my outlook. The friendly, warm, and welcoming team, along with their powerful product, made every day a valuable learning experience.

![Photo of Ahmed, Luciq team member](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/68cc6cfdb1a7468942b829ff_team_ahmed.webp)

Ahmed Salah

Sr. iOS Developer

During my time at Luciq, I’ve grown tremendously, learning from every interaction. The team is truly world-class, and I feel privileged to collaborate with some of the biggest names in tech, driving impact and innovation together.

![Photo of Yasmine, Luciq team member](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/68cc6db0d9d17aba092c93e3_team_yasmine.webp)

Yasmine Mehrez

Sr. Customer Success Manager

Working at Luciq is incredible, not because of the product, but because of the people. From the execs to all the individual contributors, we all work towards one goal: helping mobile teams and winning our users’ hearts.

![Photo of Paul, Luciq team member](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6898c7bad2e3e342ea1c43bd/68cc6d17b1fb93129744bc3e_team_paul.webp)

Paul Richard Lao

Account Executive
